# Modules of this package that are extracted Rust rather than prose.
#
#   module   crate              sources        charon scope
#
# `sources` is what the extraction is a function of: the extraction is in sync when the hash of
# those files matches the one recorded in `sync.lock`. Keep it as narrow as the scope really is --
# a wider glob costs false alarms on every unrelated edit, a narrower one lets the generated file
# go stale without the check noticing.
#
# `scope` is the `--start-from` pattern, so the module holds only what its chapter is about.
# `*` matches one path segment, not a subtree: `m::*` takes the module's own items and leaves every
# `impl Type` block out, because a method is named `m::Type::method` -- two segments deeper. Give a
# comma-separated list to include them, e.g. `m::*,m::Type::*`; each pattern is passed separately.
#
# The scope below is deliberately the narrow one. The full scope
#   ferrosa_sstable::compression::*,ferrosa_sstable::compression::Compression::*
# does bring `Compression::decompress` -- the function the ledger's decompression row is about -- but
# aeneas then hits two internal errors (`alloc::io::error::Error::other`, `alloc::boxed::From`) and
# the emitted module references `core.io.error.Error` without declaring it: 8 Lean errors,
# `synthInstanceFailed` and a type mismatch. Fix the translator first, then widen this row.
#
# Regenerate one with `./extract.sh <module>`; check them all with `./check-sync.sh`.

Storage   ferrosa-storage   src/count.rs       ferrosa_storage::count::*
Sstable   ferrosa-sstable   src/compression.rs ferrosa_sstable::compression::*
